title: Moi Moi
description: Moi Moi is a Nigeria classic prepared with black-eyed peas, red bell pepper, yellow onion, crayfish. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the dried beans or peas in plentiful cold water for 480 minutes, then drain and discard the soaking liquid; keep refrigerated in hot conditions.
Blend peeled soaked black-eyed peas with peppers, onion and water to a light smooth batter, then beat in palm oil.
Boil the eggs for about 10 minutes, cool promptly in cold water, peel and prepare as required.
Divide batter between heatproof ramekins or suitable food-safe leaves, leaving room for expansion; cover tightly, adding slices of the cooked eggs.
Steam covered portions for about 48 minutes until the center is set and fully cooked; serve warm.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
